name: Ruga Ragetotem
summary: At Camp Taurajo, Ruga Ragetotem trains warriors for the Horde. He tests them against the silithid in the southern Barrens before sending the proven toward custom armor.

sections.title: A Mentor in Camp Taurajo
sections.body: At Camp Taurajo, Ruga Ragetotem trains warriors who want to prove their strength in Kalimdor. Silithid have suddenly appeared to the south, carving hives into the Field of Giants. Ruga sends young fighters to hunt the insectoids and cut off their antennae. Those who endure the trial earn his respect and a recommendation to Thun'grim Firegaze, a renowned armorsmith.

faq.answer: Ruga Ragetotem trains warriors at Camp Taurajo in the southern Barrens. He tests fighters who hope to prove themselves to the Horde.

faq.q: What trial does Ruga give to warriors?
aliases: trial at the field of giants
faq.answer: Ruga sends warriors south to the Field of Giants to fight the newly emerged silithid. They must slay the aggressive insectoids and bring back their antennae to prove their bravery and skill in battle.

faq.q: Who does Ruga send you to after his trial?
faq.answer: After a warrior proves themselves against the silithid, Ruga sends them north to Thun'grim Firegaze, an orc armorsmith who crafts specialized armor for worthy fighters.

faq.q: Why is Ruga interested in the Field of Giants?
faq.answer: Silithid have recently invaded the Field of Giants, carving hives into the earth. Ruga uses the nearby threat to test warriors who may defend the Horde.

angles.text: As a warrior, you face the silithid to prove your skill before Ruga sends you to Thun'grim Firegaze for forged armor.
As a tauren, you find Ruga Ragetotem at Camp Taurajo, guarding the southern ranges with the strength and vigilance of the Earthmother's children.
